_about: Side kick one fixed step a shot (the owner, 2026-11-01: "sideways should still exist, but be consistent"; generated by srp-026g/scripts/recoil-sideways/make_recoil_sideways.py, SIDE_SCALE 0.55). The client moves the side kick by R - L a shot, R and L drawn uniform in the right and left ranges every shot (weapon_recoil_calculator::on_shot 0x331C50), so only their difference counts. Each weapon that has a side kick gets min = max on both sides with R - L = SIDE_SCALE x the root mean square of R - L today, signed by its bias today (the mean of R - L) or, without one, by its family's side in the script; both sides about the middle of today's bounds. The 33 weapons whose ranges are equal and fixed (no side kick today) are left alone. Top kick, recoil_power, shake and the PID gains unchanged. The card's side-kick rows (props 148-151 of weapon-details-ui-1) follow. An int bound that becomes a fraction is written as a float (as_float). Changes the simulation.
